notes.title: The Wanderer is now on sale!
notes.content:
[i]The Wanderer: Frankenstein’s Creature[/i], coproduced with La Belle Game, is a retelling of Mary Shelley’s masterpiece. 
The creature of the Wanderer is far detached from the popular monster: a blank state, with no memories or any past, ignorant of good and evil. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35810771/be1a5a73ff6ee7b0d5b851323db362a222da79c9.png[/img]

The player is given the unique opportunity to help the creature forge its own path and write its own destiny. 
Who gave it life? Why is it alive? Each choice the player makes brings them closer to the truth, in a world of astonishing beauty and inescapable despair.

🧟🏞️🔅

notes.title: Steam Awards Nomination
notes.content:
The Wanderer: Frankenstein’s Creature goes back to the roots of Mary Shelley’s legendary novel, Frankenstein, and invites players to discover a being quite different from the pop culture icon: Starring a creature born neither good nor evil, traveling through Europe in a search to find its origins and learn about humanity. This journey is emotional and challenging for both the creature and the player as beauty and kindness are often followed by darkness, fear and hate. 

[previewyoutube=82ilW4ViQQU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Changelog V1.0.6
notes.content:
- Add illustrations in the Scripturam scene book
- You can now catch the rabbit in Familia by hand (you can still use the trap, or don't catch it at all, it's your choice)
- Polish some animations in Familia and in Festum
- Fix a language issue, causing some peoples to don't see the main menu
- Fix an issue causing dialog choices not appearing if you went back to the menu before
- Fix some crash issues in Festum
- Updated to a more recent version of Unity, this may fix some issues of some users on Mac
- Fix the puzzle in Originem in some languages
- Plus a few other minor bug fixes
- Working on the mobiles versions


Known issue : 
- If you go back to the main menu while a dialogue is playing, it cause an issue if you hit continue just after. Restarting the game fix it.


The Russian translation is almost finished, the Chinese and Japanese versions are being worked on, and the Portugese-Brazilian is coming soon.

Thank you all for playing, if you have any issue, please tell us here, or on the comunity hub

notes.title: The Wanderer: Frankenstein's Creature shuffles into stores on Halloween
notes.content:
Yes, Frankenstein is the doctor, but it s nice that The Wanderer: Frankenstein s Creature is a little more neutral than calling his creation a monster. If you re retelling Mary Shelley s classic story, it s probably best to get off on the right foot, instead of insulting your protagonist right out of the gate. And besides, anything that fits into these gorgeous landscapes so well surely can t be a monster.

(more…)
